name: Ishu Kouhai Jikken 2 ~Suzumiya Haruhi no Shokushu~
original_name: 異種交配実験２　～涼宮ハルヒの触手～
source:
The second volume is about the tentacle attack against Haruhi Suzu**iya and people around her (5 characters). Illustrations and short story describe the humiliation, pregnancy and egg-laying by the tentacle.
This work is created with kiri-kiri, and can be enjoyed in a game style.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE045412.html]Dlsite[/url]]
translation:
系列第二作讲述凉宫○日及身边的人遭到触手袭击的故事，共有五名角色登场。插图搭配短篇剧情，描绘了受辱、怀孕和产卵等情节。

本作使用吉里吉里引擎制作，可以游戏形式阅读。

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE045412.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
